items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: They promised to give $1,000. See, because Gerry Mulligan and those guys get ten times the money we do.

ctx.x: Anyway, Illinois Jacquet I don't know if Jackie was supposed to remember him from " Flying Home." And he called me one day and said, "I'm not going to make it, man. They promised to give $1,000. See, because Gerry Mulligan and those guys get ten times the money we do. So they get $10,000 on a record date." I said, "Well, this is my date, man. I just want you to sit in and play the Flying Home thing." He said, "No, I'm not going to do it because those people have got to start paying us some money." He says,…
